html:
Quest Giver: Sir Reele

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Return to the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom off Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace and die. In the underlife, meet with Sir Reele.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Reele

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Missing Man, Part 4

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Return to the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom off Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace and die. In the underlife, meet with Sir Reele.

Offer:

Sir Reele said Johann's Whisker Has a large moustache, eh? That's distressful. VERY distressful.

Hypothetically speaking, I'm going to let you in on a secret. Death is bad for tourism. Well, that's not the secret, but this is: Years ago, a covert organization known as K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. was created to develop and protect the resurrection system we use today, the one where you automatically appear at the graveyard after each time you die.

Those documents you liberated include a briefing for subverting the Kingdom's resurrection system. I need more intel before I can move forward on any countermeasures--and I need your help.

First things first...return to Sir Reele and tell him, It's better if our children go to school right here rather than far away. He'll understand. Gather any new information he has and return to me.

What are you waiting for? Go to the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom and die!

Turn-in:

Sir Ving said what!?! He wants me to stay in the underlife and report back to him through you? Oh, that's just great! I was holding a sandwich when I died--whenever I eventually resurrect, I'm sure the mayonnaise will be spoiled!

Client level range: 45–100
